name: yf_news
description:
Recent news items about one ticker from Yahoo Finance (yfinance Ticker.news, falling back to Yahoo search news when that is empty).
Returns: {symbol, articles: [Yahoo news items as yfinance gives them, with title, publisher or provider, link or canonicalUrl and publish time]}; the list can be empty.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; limit (items, 1-50; default 10).
Other news sources: openbb_company_news, fmp_stock_news.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 5}
